notes.title: Update 1.1 is going live in few minutes
notes.content:
Update 1.1 for Lost In Time


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890351/edee9282ce5bbf53541c87346da800601705c28f.png[/img]


* Light intensity has been increased. You can roam the world with more sunlight now.
* Day/Night cycle speed has been increase by x1.5.
* Character sprint has been increased from 700 to 900.
* Added lights to School main building.
* Letters with clues for finding keys has been updated for easy journey.
* Added few more letters and clues on how to progress in School
* Added direction for lighthouse.
* Under construction or empty buildings has been sealed with spiral door. ( Accessible in future updates )

Need Suggestions!

If you have any suggestions for the video game kindly post them in the discussion page of Lost In Time in community hub. I would love to listen to those and improve the game as much as i can.

Thank You
